Lemma
[The backward pressure is stationary] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0103 ↗ lem:chow-iv-backward-pressure-convergence ↗ def:chow-iv-weak-stationary-pressure 1. ch29:29.14\group Backward Pressure Limit

The limit $v_\infty $ is a weak solution of \[ v_\infty \Delta _{S^2}v_\infty -|\nabla v_\infty |^2+2v_\infty ^2=0. \] It is smooth on $\{ v_\infty >0\} $, where $v_\infty ^{-1}g_{S^2}$ is flat.
